usageNotes: Use this to download an LXC appliance template from the Proxmox template repository to a local storage. The caller must have `Datastore.AllocateTemplate` permission on the target storage, and the node must be online with internet access to reach the template source. The return value is a task UPID — poll the task status endpoint to confirm the download completes before attempting to provision a container from the template.

examples.summary: Download the Ubuntu 22.04 LXC template to local storage on pve1

tips: Use GET /nodes/{node}/aplinfo first to list available templates and get the exact template string required by this endpoint.
The returned UPID can be tracked via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to detect download failures (e.g., network errors or insufficient storage space).
Template downloads go to the 'vztmpl' content type directory on the target storage; ensure the storage is configured to accept 'vztmpl' content or the request will fail.
Large templates (several hundred MB) may take a minute or more — always wait for task completion before using the template.
